fact: Eritrea inaugurated the ASYCUDA World digital customs management system in January 2026, replacing legacy software in use since 2007, according to Shabait (Ministry of Information).
source_slug: 2026-01-08 Eritrea launches ASYCUDA World digital customs system

fact: UNDP states Eritrea inaugurated ASYCUDA World, with all customs stations interconnected on an intranet for data exchange and processing, replacing a legacy system operational since 2007.
